results.source_quote: To qualify, the applicant must be a resident farmer of Maharashtra, registered under PM-KISAN, and possess valid land records (7/12 extract) in the state.
Under this scheme, eligible farmer families receive Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 each, directly transferred to their bank accounts.

EWS: Annual household income up to Rs 3 lakh; LIG: Annual household income Rs 3-6 lakh; MIG-I: Annual household income Rs 6-12 lakh; MIG-II: Annual household income Rs 12-18 lakh; Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Woman resident of Maharashtra; Age between 21 and 65 years; Annual family income not exceeding Rs 2.5 lakh
Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises; Indian citizen; Age 18 years or above
